home.kicker: Zwitshimbidzi zwa u renga zwa Afrika Tshipembe
home.headline: Hune vhaṋetshedzi vha SA vha ṱangana na u renga ha vhukuma.
home.intro: Kha vha sedze thandela dza tshitshavha dzo senguluswaho nga vhuḓiitisi na RFQ nga nḓowetshumo, vundu na ḓuvha ḽa u vala—dzi re na vhuṱumani kha zwisima zwa u thoma.
home.sourceNote: Zwikhala zwa tshitshavha zwo wanalaho kha mutevhe wa u renga wa tshiofisi.
home.supplierBody: Wanani zwibuli. Kha vha wane khwaṱhisedzo. U alusa bindu ḽau.
home.smartScoreBody: Zwo fhaṱiwa u bva kha vhuṱanzi ho sedzuluswaho ha u tevhedza na khwaṱhisedzo ya bannga.
home.buyerBody: Tshisima tsho khwaṱhisedzwaho vhaṋetshedzi. Posa dzi RFQ. U langa khouthu.
home.trackedDaily: Thengo ya tshitshavha, i tevhelwa ḓuvha ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe
home.liveFeed: Vhuṱanzi vhu tshilaho, hu si tshifanyiso
home.statsBody: Zwikhala zwa zwino u bva kha eTender dza muvhuso dza tshiofisi, dzine dza ṱoliwa nga vhuḓiitisi u itela nḓivhadzo dzo khanselwaho kana dzo no ṋetshedzwaho.
home.new48: Ntswa nga murahu ha awara dza 48
home.network: Nethiweke ya thengo Afrika Tshipembe yo vha yo lindela.
home.supplierPoint1: Kha vha ṅwale bindu ḽavho. Kha vha dzhenise nomboro yavho ya CSD na ṱhanziela ya B-BBEE.
home.supplierPoint2: Ṱanganedzani SmartScore—muelo waṋu wa u fulufhedzea, u vhonalaho kha murengi muṅwe na muṅwe.
home.supplierPoint3: RFQ dzo ṱanganelanaho dzi ḓa kha inwi. A hu tshe na maḓuvha a u vala o xelaho.
home.verified48: Yo khwaṱhisedzwa nga awara dza 48. Ahuna garaṱa ya tshikolodo.
home.smartScoreIntro: Muṋetshedzi muṅwe na muṅwe u hwala SmartScore—yo ṱoliwaho kha zwisima zwiṋa zwa tshiofisi zwa SA, zwo senguluswaho nga tshigwada tshashu.
home.nationalTreasury: Muhasho wa Gwama ḽa Lushaka CSD
home.smartScoreRank: Score 90 kana u fhira na profile yavho i dzula ya u thoma kha u setsha ha vharengi.
home.buyerPoint1: Posa RFQ nga miniti mitanu. Setha ṱhoḓea yaṋu ya B-BBEE, vundu, na tshikalo tsha ndeme.
home.buyerPoint2: Vhaṋetshedzi vho khwaṱhisedzwaho vha ḓivhadzwa nga u ṱavhanya.
home.buyerPoint3: Vhambedzani khouthu nga thungo—iṅwe na iṅwe yo hwala SmartScore na bege ya u khwaṱhisedza.
home.verifiedOrganisations: Kha madzangano o khwaṱhisedzwaho. Mimasipala yo ṱanganedza.
home.trustOfficialTitle: Zwo khwaṱhisedzwa u lwa na rekhodo dza tshiofisi
home.trustOfficialBody: CSD, SARS, CIPC na vhuṱanzi ha bannga—ho senguluswa nga tshigwada tshashu phanḓa ha musi muṋetshedzi naho e ufhio a tshi bvelela.
home.trustMatchingTitle: U Ṱanganelana ha Nḓowetshumo na Vunḓu
home.trustMatchingBody: Zwikhala zwo vuleaho zwi ṱanganedzwa na phrofaele dza vhaṋetshedzi nga nḓowetshumo yo ṅwaliswaho na vundu.
home.trustNotificationsBody: Vhaṋetshedzi vha a tsivhudzwa hu sa athu fhela mimunithi ya RFQ i tshimbilelanaho yo poselwa.
home.trustAuditBody: Khouthu iṅwe na iṅwe, pfufho, na thengiselano zwi a ṅwalwa na u rumelwa nnḓa u itela odithi dza u renga.
